description: This file defines functions and utilities for translating JIT schema to the dispatcher API in PyTorch, focusing on unboxed calling conventions and argument handling.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of a FunctionSchema using cpp.name.

methods.name: argumenttype_type
methods.description: Generates a NamedCType for a given Type with specific attributes.

methods.name: argument_type
methods.description: Creates a NamedCType for an Argument, considering mutability and other flags.

methods.name: returns_type
methods.description: Determines the CType for a sequence of Return objects.

methods.name: jit_arguments
methods.description: Extracts a list of Arguments from a FunctionSchema, including special handling for SelfArgument and TensorOptionsArguments.

methods.name: argument
methods.description: Creates a Binding object for an Argument with specified flags.

methods.name: arguments
methods.description: Generates a list of Bindings for all arguments of a FunctionSchema.
